name: Toujou Akira
source: [spoiler] Before the events of the game he raped his sister Chigusa and she became pregnant with Kazuya and Hikari. After their birth he took Kazuya while he left Hikari to be raised by his sister. He never tells his son or daughter about their true origins. [/spoiler]
